android.desc:
📱 Phone Health Checker

Phone Health Checker is a comprehensive diagnostic app designed to help you understand the current condition of your Android device through detailed hardware analysis and real-time system data.

With a clean interface and focused testing tools, the app provides clear insights into your phone’s battery, sensors, screen, audio components, and thermal behavior - all in one place.

🔍 Complete Device Diagnostics

Battery Health
Battery level and charging status
Temperature and voltage monitoring
Charging behavior analysis
Health indicators based on system data
Sensor Testing
Accelerometer
Gyroscope
Proximity sensor
Light sensor
Magnetometer (compass)

Each sensor is tested using live readings and clearly reported for quick evaluation.

Screen & Touch Tests
Dead pixel detection
Color and brightness checks
Multi-touch testing
Touch response validation
Audio & Microphone Checks
Speaker output test
Microphone recording test
Stereo balance support
Basic sound quality evaluation
Thermal Monitoring
Device temperature tracking
Performance behavior under load
Cooling response observation
Thermal status indicators

📊 Clear Health Overview

Phone Health Checker combines individual test results into an easy-to-understand health overview, helping you quickly assess how your device is performing today.

Each result is presented with clear labels and visual indicators, making it easy to identify areas that may need attention.

🎯 Designed for Everyday Use

This app is ideal for:
Checking a phone before buying or selling
Monitoring device condition over time
Verifying hardware functionality
Running quick diagnostics when issues are suspected
Understanding how your device behaves under real usage

✨ Simple, Clean Experience

Fast one-tap scans
Clear test results
No account required
Works offline
Lightweight and efficient
Designed for a wide range of Android devices

🔐 Transparent Permission Usage

Permissions are requested only when required for specific tests, such as audio diagnostics or report saving. All usage is explained directly in the app.

Phone Health Checker helps you stay informed about your device with clear diagnostics and reliable system insights, giving you confidence in your phone’s condition whenever you need it.

quotes.text:
Hi All,

Over time I built a small set of Android apps, mostly single-purpose utilities and one
developer-focused companion tool.

Utility apps (no accounts, no subscriptions):
- Offline PDF & EPUB reader/editor
- QR & barcode scanner and generator
- Phone hardware and battery diagnostics

Developer tool:
- VSCoder Copilot – a mobile companion for VS Code / GitHub Copilot workflows

For the utility apps, the focus was:
- minimal permissions
- no background services
- all on-device processing

VSCoder is different by nature and supports optional paid features.

I’d appreciate feedback, especially on UX decisions, permission discipline, and whether
there’s still room for focused utility software on Android.

Google Play links:

PDF & EPUB Reader–Editor
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pdfepub.readereditor

QR & Barcode Scanner
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.emirbaycan.qrbarcode.scanner

Phone Health Checker
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.phonehealthcheckernew

VSCoder Copilot
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.emirbaycan.vscodercopilot
